podman.qualification: Real podman compose invoked the checked-in absolute fake provider and produced prod-profile.json. The deterministic test lane uses fake-podman.sh so CI does not depend on Podman installation.

captureCommands: PODMAN_COMPOSE_PROVIDER=<absolute fake provider> podman compose <prod-profile argv>
captureNormalization: capture.sh appends one trailing newline because Docker Compose 5.3.1 emits formatted JSON without one; JSON content is otherwise byte-for-byte frontend stdout.
